The '''Slave level''' was the lowest level of the [[Great Well]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ophideraan]]. It was the level where the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] were confined by the [[Serpent Masters]]. It comprised an island on which slaves drilled to keep water flowing in the caverns. The bottom of the sinkhole was linked to a cavern known as the [[Cavern of the Serpents]].

[[File:ClassicStarWars5-Epic.png|thumb|left|180px|Luke Skywalker in the Slave level.]]

==History==
Several years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Josen Shire]] and his daughter [[Tanith Shire|Tanith]] were forced to crash-land their ship on Ophideraan, where they were enslaved and put to work maintaining the Great Well in the Slave level.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] also crashed on the planet and was enslaved in the Slave level before defeating the Serpent Masters.
